propositions: Malformed or unreadable rebar.toml currently causes gate_enabled to swallow ConfigError into GateState.UNREADABLE and silently proceed; the operator ruling mandates this must raise ConfigError instead.
gate_enabled must raise a chained ConfigError naming the gate label, ticket, and parse fault; GateState.UNREADABLE is removed as unreachable.
Claim and transition-close operations must fail loudly (exit ≠ 0 on CLI, typed raise in library) when config is unreadable, before any work or locks are acquired.
CLI main() must gain a ConfigError exception boundary rendering errors cleanly to stderr without traceback, matching existing ConfigError surfacing from -c overrides.
Read-only operations (list, show, search) that do not resolve gates are unaffected; error scope is gate resolution only.

Acceptance criteria verified: malformed config raises ConfigError in gate_enabled, claim/close fail loudly with typed error leaving ticket in prior state, pre-lock error guarantee preserved, readable config behavior unchanged, docs updated to contract.
